FORM 10-K

TIDEWATER ANALYTICS CORP

Item 1. Business

Tidewater Analytics Corp. sells analytics software to lenders and insurers in North America.

Competition

We compete with Harborlight Data in the market for income verification and consumer credit analytics.

Properties

Our offices are two blocks from the campus of Quillfeather Systems in a district we have occupied since 2011.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

We depend on a limited number of data suppliers, and the loss of any one of them could harm our business.
